full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 64
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament
Tuesday, Ashoj 13, 2083
10:00 AM
Presentation of Committee Report on Bill
1. Honorable Chairperson of the Education, Health and Information Technology Committee, Ojaswi Sherchan, will present the "Report of the Committee on the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2083".
Management Work
2. On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister and Defense Minister Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will:
a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "National Defense University Bill, 2083".
b) Introduce the "National Defense University Bill, 2083".
3. Honorable Minister for Infrastructure Development Sunil Lamsal will:
a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Diploma in Engineering Council Bill, 2083".
b) Introduce the "Diploma in Engineering Council Bill, 2083".
4. On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present a proposal for consideration of the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws, 2083".
5. Honorable Minister for Health and Food Hygiene Nisha Mehta will present a proposal for consideration of the "Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Sciences Academy Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
